summary: Found the letter-suffix ask directly conflicts with plan-format.md's explicit, recent 'must not be used' decision (from the reasoned-exclusions task) -- recommend keeping letters unsupported and making non-conforming headings loud instead. Recommend rejecting [DESCOPED] in favor of the already-wired [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. FILE SCOPE is missing 3 known consumer sites (both implementation agents' Stage 5a, commands/task.md).
decisions_made: Recommend NOT widening the phase-number grammar to accept letter suffixes (Phase Na); plan-format.md already prohibits this as a deliberate, evidenced decision from the prior reasoned-exclusions task, not an oversight.

Recommend instead making a non-conforming phase-number token a loud, visible warning at every accounting site (generalizing the existing 'no conforming headings' inconclusive-and-pass-through branch), rather than silently under-counting or truncating it.
Recommend rejecting [DESCOPED] entirely; [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]'s five-condition admission test already covers the whole-phase-descope case with zero new accounting sites needed.

Recommend expanding FILE SCOPE to include agents/general-implementation-agent.md, agents/general-implementation-hard-agent.md, and commands/task.md, per plan-format.md's own (already-incomplete) consumer-site list.
Recommend a new shared library scripts/lib/phase-heading-patterns.sh modeled directly on the existing scripts/lib/task-reference-patterns.sh precedent as the 'single named anchor'.
